subject: It brought a tear to my eye...
author: ZombieTron
body:
a few actually! 😢

When Xandu came home today, he was like "well we don't play it anymore anyway..."

But, that really isn't the point. It is like we had a favourite place to hang out, and we were there everyday for a few years, a bunch of friends... as time went on, we all went our seperate ways, but every now and then, if one of us returns to our favourite place, we might bump into someone we haven't seen for ages, we might remember the good times we used to have, and we might meet some new people and have some new good times.

Today, we got the news that our favourite place is going to be demolished on the 15th of April, and although we don't go there everyday anymore, to know that it will no longer exist for anybody to go to, is really very sad.

subject: At the time I wrote this
author: umopapisdnpuaq
body:
At the time I wrote this (Dec 2007) I would have taken 2 more years if that was all we could get. It still doesn't seem like it's time to say goodbye though.

Burnout 3: Still Alive (but damage critical)

This was a triumph.
I'm making a note here:
HUGE SUCCESS.
It's hard to overstate.
My satisfaction.
Burnout 3 online.
The servers must not.
Go off. Again.
For, the good, of all, of us.
Except, the ones who time out.

But there's no sense lagging,
Stop uploading those files.
You just keep on boosting,
'til you run out of miles.
And, the takedowns get done,
And, the red team has won.
Now, the blue team is not,
Still alive.

I'm not even angry.
I'm being so, sincere, right now.
Even though, you took me down.
And killed me.
And ruined my lap time.
And then stole my boost, when I, respawned.
I was just about to win.
But that does not matter now.
The important factor.
Is we are back online.
So we can enjoy.
Another wonderful time.
I was sad it was gone.
Think of what we'd have done.
If we only would have had.
Burnout 5.

Burnout Paradise.
It will be good, and make a change.
Maybe you'll find, it's more fun,
Than Revenge.
Maybe Takedown too...
THAT WAS A JOKE, HA HA, FAT CHANCE.
Anyway, this game is great.
It's so addictive and fast.
And it's still, fun, driving, even when, you're in last.
Because first place, can just hit a bus, and get passed.
No matter who has won.
All the battling, has been fun.
In the end, we are all.
Still alive.


And believe me. I am.. still alive.
On 3rd 360. but I'm still alive.
Back on the xbox 1 and I'm still alive.
On backup burnout disc.I am. still alive.
When the server's dead I will be. still alive.
Still alive?
Still alive!

Link -> Almost brings a tear to the eye now

subject: Paid The Price!
author: umopapisdnpuaq
body:
So it looks like more things original xbox live was holiding back include plans for windows 7 on mobile phones.

www.majornelson.com/archive/2010/02/15/xbox-live-coming-to-windows-phones-7-series.aspx

Windows Phone 7 series ships later this year, it will come with Xbox LIVE support. Specifically, the Windows Phone 7 Games hub will allow you to:

  • Collect Achievements and build your Gamerscore
  • View Xbox LIVE leaderboards
  • See your Xbox LIVE Avatar
  • Access Spotlight feeds, including the latest tips and tricks, game news, updates and more
  • Add Xbox LIVE friends to your friends list while out on the go
  • Turn-based (asynchronous) multiplayer gaming

Wow! All my FAVOURITE parts of the dashboard while on the go. Note how actually playing (turn-based) games is last, almost an afterthought.

Look out iPhone!
